source: Formulas.calcPhysDam(attacker, target, skill, shld, crit, ss) with a skill
note: result = damage (double, before the (int) cast of PhysicalDamage). With RandomizePhysicalSkillDamage on the weapon random multiplier draws twice (once for the config, once unconditionally: Java quirk), the crit (calcCrit with the skill) is a separate call (skill_formulas_skill_crit.json) and passed as a flag. shld 2 returns 1 before any draw. intermediate adds the trait bonus (calcAttackTraitBonus) and attribute bonus the function multiplies in. Every case has 'script' (the unit values u in [0,1) that were consumed) and 'rnd' (every Rnd call in order: method, bound, returned value; get_int bound b returns floor(u*b), get_int_range o,b returns o+floor(u*(b-o+1)), nextGaussian is 2u-1 in the harness). Calls that draw nothing are not recorded. Replay the returned values in order and check method and bound.

geometry.note: The target stands at 'target'. The attacker has heading 0 and z = target z + z_diff, and stands at attacker_xy_by_relation[relation] (found by trying 32 spots 40 units away until the real isInFrontOf / isOnSideOf / isBehind agree). Same spots as the formulas_*.json files.
